data.long_meaning: The name Bahuleya is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words 'Bahu' meaning many and 'Ile' or 'Aya' meaning virtues. This name signifies a person who is blessed with numerous virtues and is highly regarded in society. The name Bahuleya carries the meaning “Blessed with many virtues” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bahuleya usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with many virtues and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Endowed with many virtues, pious and blessed.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahuleya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
